prompt:
A 48-year-old with moderate-to-severe ARDS is being ventilated with a lung-protective strategy.

Based on EPVent2, should esophageal pressure-guided PEEP be used routinely in this setting?

rubric_items.text: Concludes that EPVent2 does not support routine esophageal pressure-guided PEEP in moderate-to-severe ARDS.
States that in EPVent2 the primary endpoint and 28-day mortality were not different between groups, with supporting statistics.
Notes that there was no difference in ventilator-free days.

Acknowledges that rescue therapy was reduced (with numbers and P value) and that barotrauma was similar, and gives the clinical implication that this does not establish a clear patient-centered benefit supporting routine use.
